title: I Let ChatGPT Handle My Entire Workload #chatgpt #ai #shorts
description:
The ChatGPT desktop app just got a Work mode that acts like an agent: it reads your connected apps and files, makes a plan, and builds finished docs, slides, spreadsheets, even live websites. Here's what Chat, Work, and Codex each do and how to use ChatGPT Work on your own tasks.

#Shorts #ChatGPT #AI

Get the ChatGPT Work setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GWiBc6EQc7QAACLxZbayT7d4m8aQCDoC-eqNF0Z6vVw/edit?usp=sharing
